output.summary: The function processes an input byte array and returns a 32-bit value based on a bitwise transformation algorithm.

claims.text: Applies a bitwise transformation to each byte in the input array.
Processes each byte in the input array sequentially.
Returns 0 when the input length is 0.
Returns the bitwise complement of a 32-bit value when the input length is non-zero.
Does not modify the input array.
Uses the constant 0xedb88320 in the bitwise transformation.
